attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Beyond the test fix, this changes production index-creation semantics in AzureAISearchIndexManager (return value for 'already exists' flips from true to false, and a null-conditional check is removed) and alters error-path returns in ElasticsearchIndexManager, plus reworks Lucene writer/reader locking and disposal logic—all core indexing paths used by every tenant, where subtle regressions in concurrency or return-value contracts would be hard to catch pre-merge."}
